countermodels: SCALAR_COLLAPSE: replace p0,p1,p2 by their mean before D; rejects because it erases the inherited nonequilibrium state and forces zero transport/entropy production.
EDGE_WITHHELD: remove one exact K3 transport edge; rejects because it breaks inherited complete-support/O(2) symmetry and changes the history.
ANTI_DIFFUSION: flip the sign of G_D; rejects because entropy production changes sign and positivity/stability can fail.
NONCONSERVATIVE: perturb one generator row sum; rejects because total carrier/Q_total is no longer conserved.
PUBLIC_TEMPERATURE_ANCHOR: insert Kelvin/MeV or observed transition targets; forbidden by the sealed-generation firewall.
